description: This file defines a React component called HelloWorld for a Remotion video project. It imports various modules from 'remotion' and other external sources, sets up schema validation with 'zod', and exports a React functional component that manages animation timing and rendering of child components such as Logo, Title, and Subtitle.

methods.name: HelloWorld
methods.description: React functional component that creates an animated video scene with logos and text, using Remotion APIs for frame-based animations.
